title: Finite discrete G-action realization
statement: Let K, Ks, and Omega be fields in Type u, with compatible algebra structures K → Ks → Omega, Ks a separable closure of K, and Omega algebraically closed. Set S = Spec K, J = its small etale topology, p = the point Spec Omega → S, G = Gal(Ks/K), and w = max(u+1,v). Let T : Sheaf J (Type w) → DiscreteContAction (Type w) G be a functor and j : U ∘ T ≅ p.sheafFiber a natural isomorphism, where U forgets the action. Assume the canonical germ formula of lem-exc-galois-stalk-action-functor: for each g, each extending K-automorphism tau of Omega, x' = Spec(tau) ≫ x, and section z, j(g • j⁻¹(germ_x z)) = germ_x' z. Then every M whose underlying set is finite is in T.essImage, namely there exists a sheaf F and an equivariant isomorphism T(F) ≅ M. This includes the empty finite set and arbitrary finite sets in Type w.

proof.text: Transport the finite action of M onto Fin n in Type u along a bijection; continuity is preserved. Apply etaleFieldGsets to obtain an etale K-scheme X with that small G-set of Ks-points.

The representable h_X is a sheaf. Lift its values to Type w and use the representable-stalk isomorphism to identify its stalk with Omega-points of X. Each such point has finite separable residue field and therefore factors uniquely through Ks. This identifies the stalk with the original finite action as sets.

Extend each g to Omega and apply the assumed canonical germ formula to the identity germ of X. Together with the precomposition action formula in etaleFieldGsets it makes the bijection equivariant; its inverse is equivariant, giving T(h_X) ≅ M. The empty case uses the empty etale scheme.

theorem galoisStalkActionFunctor_finite_mem_essImage
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let J := S.smallEtaleTopology
    let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω))
    let p := pointSmallEtale s
    let G := Gal(Ks/K)
    let V := ObjectProperty.ι (ContAction.IsDiscrete (V := Type (max (u + 1) v)) (G := G))
      ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (Action.IsContinuous (V := Type (max (u + 1) v)) (G := G))
    ∀ (T : Sheaf J (Type (max (u + 1) v)) ⥤
        DiscreteContAction (Type (max (u + 1) v)) G)
      (j : T ⋙ V ⋙ Action.forget (Type (max (u + 1) v)) G ≅ p.sheafFiber),
      (∀ (F : Sheaf J (Type (max (u + 1) v))) (g : G)
          (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (X : S.Etale) (x x' : p.fiber.obj X)
          (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
          (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
        (j.hom.app F) ((T.obj F).obj.obj.ρ g
          ((j.inv.app F) (p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z))) =
            p.toPresheafFiber X x' F.obj z) →
      ∀ (M : DiscreteContAction (Type (max (u + 1) v)) G),
        Finite M.obj.obj.V → T.essImage M
